Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — I'll be on unpaid medical leave Apr 15–May 12. Quick Q: will my pre-tax 401(k) deferrals stop once there's no payroll? If I elect COBRA, does that affect loan repayments or employer match? Also what's the payroll cutoff I should be aware of?
Sam (Payroll): Short answer — yes, deferrals stop when there's no paycheck. Employer match stops too since match is payroll-based. Loan repayments via payroll stop with your pay. You can continue loan payments directly to the plan vendor via ACH or set up a manual-pay arrangement.
Jordan (Benefits): Yep — COBRA only covers medical/dental/vision, not retirement plans. COBRA does not carry employer 401(k) contributions. For loan repayment options, call the plan vendor (I DM'd the phone earlier). Internal link: https://benefits.redwood.com/401k/loans — has steps to set up ACH.
Ava (People Ops): Got it. Thanks. What's the latest deferral-change cutoff for the Apr 13 paycheck? My last paycheck before leave is Apr 13.
Sam (Payroll): For the Apr 13 pay, submit deferral changes by EOD Apr 5 to be safe. If you miss it we can do an off-cycle correction but it's a pain. If you want contributions to stop on leave, set deferral to 0 effective Apr 15.
Lina (People Ops): Note: if you're unpaid for more than one pay period you lose eligibility for the company match until you're back on payroll — we can flag your record to avoid retro match errors.
Ava (People Ops): :thumbsup: Can someone DM me the vendor ACH number so I can set up the loan repayment?
Jordan (Benefits): DMed you the vendor phone + a one-page ACH guide. If you'd prefer, we can request a payroll-to-plan escrow so repayments don't lapse — needs benefits admin sign-off, lmk.
BenefitsBot: COBRA packet reminder — COBRA election packet will be emailed within 14 days of the leave start date. See #hr-docs for plan docs.
Sam (Payroll): I'll add a note to your payroll record. Ava — please confirm here once you've set up ACH so we can coordinate any catch-up or off-cycle if needed.
